text: [LLM DRAFT] Are you currently breastfeeding and experiencing a painful, swollen lump in your breast?
[LLM DRAFT] Do you have a fever, chills, or pus draining from a painful area on your breast while breastfeeding?
[LLM DRAFT] Are you currently in your first trimester of pregnancy and experiencing a painful, swollen lump in your breast?
[LLM DRAFT] Do you have redness, warmth, or pus draining from a painful area on your breast along with a fever?
[LLM DRAFT] Are you currently in your second trimester of pregnancy and experiencing a painful, swollen lump or redness in your breast?
[LLM DRAFT] Have you developed a fever, chills, or generally feel unwell along with breast pain during your pregnancy?
[LLM DRAFT] Are you currently breastfeeding or within a few weeks of giving birth?
[LLM DRAFT] Do you have a painful, red, swollen lump on your breast accompanied by fever or chills?
[LLM DRAFT] Do you have a painful, swollen lump or area on your breast that feels hot or looks red?
[LLM DRAFT] Have you noticed pus or unusual discharge draining from your nipple or the skin of your breast?
[LLM DRAFT] Do you have a high fever or chills along with your breast pain and swelling?
[LLM DRAFT] Did a doctor recently tell you that a routine mammogram or breast biopsy found abnormal cells called lobular carcinoma in situ (LCIS)?
[LLM DRAFT] Have you noticed a new breast lump, thickening, or skin dimpling on either of your breasts?
[LLM DRAFT] Did you receive pathology results showing abnormal cells in both breasts?
[LLM DRAFT] Do you have a thick, sticky discharge from your right nipple that is dark green or black?
[LLM DRAFT] Is the skin around your right nipple red, swollen, or unusually warm to the touch?
[LLM DRAFT] Is your right nipple inverted or pulled inward recently?
[LLM DRAFT] Have you noticed a fast-growing, firm, painless red or violet lump on the skin of your breast?
[LLM DRAFT] Has a doctor told you that a skin lesion on your breast has spread to your lymph nodes?
[LLM DRAFT] Do you feel a distinct, single lump in your left breast?
[LLM DRAFT] Is the lump in your left breast accompanied by sudden, severe pain or rapid skin changes like severe redness or swelling?
[LLM DRAFT] Do you feel a distinct, single lump in your right breast?
[LLM DRAFT] Is the lump in your right breast accompanied by sudden, severe pain or rapid skin changes?
[LLM DRAFT] Do you feel a distinct, single lump in your breast?
[LLM DRAFT] Is the breast lump soft to firm, smooth, and easily movable under the skin?
[LLM DRAFT] Did the breast lump appear or change rapidly, or is it accompanied by skin dimpling or bloody nipple discharge?
[LLM DRAFT] Do you have a severe injury where part of your chest wall, ribs, or back has been torn or cut off?
[LLM DRAFT] Is the wound on your chest actively bleeding heavily or is there exposed bone or tissue?
